units.rawText: It seems you're not very used to cheering people on, Master. Nevertheless, I accept your feelings in the spirit they were given.

units.rawText: Next time, I'll open with that song I wrote just for you.

units.rawText: Surely they won't notice that little selfishness of mine, will they?
